shabad.source_english: Codes of Conduct and Other Panthic Sources

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਠ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ਜਹਿੰ ਜਹਿਂ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਬਖਾਨ॥
verses.translit_en: paaTh gra(n)th ko hoi jahi(n) jahi(n) har kathaa bakhaan||

en.bdb: Wherever the prayers and exegesis of the Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji are being recited;

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਕਛੁ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਬੋਲਈ ਸੁਨੀਏ ਲਾਇ ਧਿਆਨ॥੩੫॥
verses.translit_en: teh kachh avar na boliee sune'ee lai dhiaan||35||

en.bdb: Do not speak there and listen with concentration.
